content: {"episode_id":"ep-05030","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Please review the denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), denied under CO-197 because required authorization was missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency and a personal history of transient ischemic attacks. Given concern for paroxysmal arrhythmias contributing to these symptoms and potential embolic risk, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period."}
